name: The Coldhewn woods have their Dun Morogh Trees again (#11053)
contract: Quest 500005 Timber for the Coldhewn needs Frostpine Logs, which drop at 100% from the Dun Morogh Tree 2300580. The 30 trees (guids 7914150-7914179) were deleted by the GatherMate import and never re-inserted, so only Forestwood trees stood around Coldhewn Camp. They are spawned again at the spots rev_20260925_12 placed them.
